python 3.12.10
numpy 2.5.0

No virtual environment was built for this run. It needs only the standard library and numpy:
the chains are read through a restricted unpickler and the statistics are means, standard
deviations and percentiles over float64 arrays. scipy is not used and not installed.

Scripts are run with `python -P`, which keeps the current directory off sys.path. `-I` would
be stricter but also hides site-packages, so numpy would not import.
